name: Gujarati Undhiyu
ingredients: 1 small potato and 1 raw banana, cubed
1 cup surti papdi or green beans
¼ cup (30 g) besan and ¼ cup chopped methi, for muthia
2 tbsp chopped coriander, 2 green chillies, 1 tsp ginger and 3 garlic cloves, ground for the green masala
½ tsp each ajwain, cumin and turmeric
steps: Mix besan, methi, a pinch of turmeric, ajwain and salt with a little water into a dough. Shape into small rolls and bake at 200°C for 15 minutes.
Mix the coconut with the ground green masala, lemon and salt. Stuff the brinjals with some of it.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot, crackle the cumin, and add the potato, sweet potato, banana, papdi and the remaining masala with ¼ cup water.
Place the stuffed brinjals on top, cover tightly and cook on low heat for 25 minutes without stirring.
Add the baked muthia for the last 5 minutes. Serve warm.
note: A winter Surti speciality. Traditionally deep-fried muthia are baked here to cut fat.
